name: Occultation Rime
description: Occultation Rime is a cold world made remarkable by its breathable atmosphere and the frost forests that thrive despite the sub-zero temperatures. The planet is periodically occulted by a large companion body, creating long periods of darkness during which auroral displays intensify and paint the ice fields in curtains of green and violet light. Glacial lake chains connect the frost forest biomes, their surfaces frozen but their depths kept liquid by geothermal warmth.

The air is bitterly cold but clean, carrying the sharp crystal scent of fresh ice and the subtle organic sweetness of the frost forests. During occultation periods, when the companion body blocks the star, the world transforms into an aurora-lit wonderland where the forests glow with borrowed light. The silence between auroral displays is profound, broken only by the whisper of wind across ice and the occasional crack of thermal contraction in the frozen lakes.

The flora of Occultation Rime has evolved to photosynthesize auroral light, a capability found nowhere else in the explored galaxy. Their cellular structures contain pigments that absorb the specific wavelengths of auroral emissions, converting them into metabolic energy with surprising efficiency. During the occultation periods, when auroral activity is strongest, the forests enter their peak growth phase, expanding across the ice fields in visible real-time.

The medicinal compounds produced by the aurora-photosynthetic flora are unique and extraordinarily valuable, effective against a range of neurological conditions that resist conventional treatment. Harvesting must be carefully timed to the occultation cycle, as the compounds are only produced during active auroral photosynthesis. The planet has become a destination for both pharmaceutical researchers and those suffering from untreatable conditions, creating an unusual mix of science and pilgrimage.
